sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def dash_state(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        r0=n['boundary'][0][0]; c0=n['boundary'][0][1]
        if n['color'] in ('B','w') and 32<=r0<=50 and n['pixels']<=4:
            out[(r0,c0)]=n['color']
    return out
cur=dash_state(current_frame)
# group by column (c0) and row-band
cols=sorted(set(c for (r,c) in cur))
print("dash cols:", cols)
def show(state):
    # print grid rows 33..49 for each col
    rows=range(33,50)
    for c in cols:
        colstate=[state.get((r,c),'.' ) for r in rows]
        print(c, ''.join(colstate))
print("=== CURRENT ===")
show(cur)
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':33,'col':39}])
print("clicked (33,39), board_changed:", res.get('board_changed'))
new=dash_state(current_frame)
print("diff:", {k:(cur.get(k),new.get(k)) for k in set(cur)|set(new) if cur.get(k)!=new.get(k)})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def dash_state(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        r0=n['boundary'][0][0]; c0=n['boundary'][0][1]
        if n['color'] in ('B','w') and 32<=r0<=50 and n['pixels']<=4:
            out[(r0,c0)]=n['color']
    return out
cur=dash_state(current_frame)
# group by column (c0) and row-band
cols=sorted(set(c for (r,c) in cur))
print("dash cols:", cols)
def show(state):
    # print grid rows 33..49 for each col
    rows=range(33,50)
    for c in cols:
        colstate=[state.get((r,c),'.' ) for r in rows]
        print(c, ''.join(colstate))
print("=== CURRENT ===")
show(cur)
